reviewer.method: Personally read all 43 pages of held accepted-manuscript layout text, including all methods, results, discussion, 43 references, legends and Table 1. Read all seven original figure images in 300-dpi detail crops, all Table 1 cells/headers/footnote in original page pixels 34–36, and title/DOI/preproof identity. Read all seven assigned packets, including every alternate, 70 phenotype entries and seven alleles. This is actual source reading, not automated preparation credit. Supplementary Figures S1–S7, Methods and References remain unavailable; final published version not obtained. No inherited canonical review overwritten.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF reading exposed aggregate history and a historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 case-specific rank. No target-case inference ranks, inference-output files or benchmark outcome summaries consulted. This review is not blinded.
